subs.text: I believe in you. I've also attached the terms of that belief.
Lancer Gate. Crossfire. Lancers fire across the lane, never along it.
That was close, and close is billable. Thank you for your proximity.
Your first live lock! Intel filed. Every scan helps the Authority map its lanes.
Oh! That crystal is a recovered flight recorder. Please don't open it.
You're opening it. It's opening.
Recording. Pilot zero one two one. Last Approach. Weapon status: cold.
Pilot zero one two one, your weapon is cold. Please fire. Please fire.
Pilot, please.
You stopped! Why did you stop?! Nobody stops! Nobody EVER stops!
Look! The little ships! No guns! They fly my lanes because I keep them free! FREE!
Do you know what free means?!
Non-performance confirmed. Pilot zero one two one, recall initiated.
Thank you for your service.
No. No, no, no! Don't you take him! He STOPPED!
That recording was corrupted. Please disregard it.
Welcome back, Pilot zero one two two.
Spread shot equipped! Isn't it pretty?
Proximity bonus! Please stop finding new ways to earn it.
A disarm. That is forty percent.
I am sure you had a reason, and I am sure it was a good one.
Last Approach. Everything they have.
Analysts say the Warden is down to its last reserves.
This is what a winning quarter looks like!
Reminder: pickups are Lane Authority property. Please don't get attached.
You're cutting it fine. The ship's paint would like a word.
Warning. The Warden approaches. This is it, Pilot. Everything we trained for.
Remember the briefing.
The Warden.
STOP! Stop right there! Do you have ANY idea how long it takes to grow a scout?!
That is not the voice from the briefing.
Every cycle they send another one! Shiny ship! Big gun! NO MANNERS!
I am the Warden! I keep these lanes! And I am SO TIRED of saying that!
Turn around. Go home. With that gun, the lanes stay closed!
Proceed with the engagement, Pilot.
Statements by the Warden are not covered by your contract.
My POD! Do you have ANY idea how long it takes to grow a pod?!
That's a lot of grazing. Are you doing that on purpose?
You're doing that on purpose.
Hit me again! Go on! It's not like I have FEELINGS! I have SEVERAL!
Scouts, to me! No, not AT him, AROUND him! Protect the lane!
Hit me again! Go on! It's not like I have FEELINGS! I have SEVERAL!
